summary: The complete source domain is the fixed interval from 1 through 3,999, and every canonical Roman numeral has bounded length, so runtime scaling cannot provide an honest asymptotic verdict.

replacement_checks.evidence: The current solution performs exactly 13 denomination iterations, emits at most 15 Roman symbols for any legal input, and stores only a fixed table and bounded result fragments.
An independent digit-place lookup oracle checks every integer from 1 through 3,999 against both the app-local and immutable native implementations and verifies every authored expected result.
